summary: Completed Phase 6 (Harness Migration Tranche A -- The Lint Suites). Migrated 25 test suites (the 7 test-lint-*.sh suites from the Phase 3/5 cluster plus 18 of the smallest remaining core suites, cost-checked against suite-cost-hints.txt) onto common.sh's test harness, deleting each suite's own hand-rolled pass/fail/info, REPO_ROOT resolution, resolve_candidate, and mktemp-d+trap boilerplate where the shape matched. 23 of 25 suites' output is byte-identical before/after; 2 carry cosmetic-only diffs with identical assertion counts and PASS/FAIL case names. Two migration-script defects were caught by the mandated before/after diff and fixed before closing. NET-TEST -355 for this phase. file_scope was missing the 18 non-lint paths; appended them and landed a follow-up commit for files the phase-commit wrapper's containment check had dropped. 14 of 20 plan phases remain.
